cohort: The study included 560 healthy infants, comprising 115 preterm and 445 term infants.
finding: The study found that blood pH and gas analytes (BPGA) are dependent on gestational age, birth weight, delivery mode, and gender in healthy preterm and term infants.
mod_finding: BPGA levels, specifically HbF, BE, HCO3, and Lac, were found to differ when corrected for delivery mode, and overall BPGA was dependent on delivery mode.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken within 24 hours of birth.
